messages:
sam.king: hey team — just noticed acct acct-742 got billed for 145,032 tokens on invoice #INV-2026-02-28 but the dashboard CSV shows 98,741 tokens for the same period. line items show both "Pro Plan (monthly commit)" and "Pro Plan - overage". did we change metering mid-month? :confused:

anita.chen: thanks for flagging. can you paste the invoice id and the dashboard export csv slice? also which timezone/window you used for the export?

sam.king: invoice INV-2026-02-28. I exported dashboard > Billing > Usage > CSV for 2026-02-01..2026-02-28 (UTC). attaching a quick sample row: 

```
account_id,model,tokens,period_start,period_end
acct-742,text-davinci-003,98741,2026-02-01,2026-02-28
```

sam.king: full CSV is >10k rows, but totals match the UI number. invoice shows these line items: 
- Pro Plan (monthly commit): $2000 - covers up to 100k tokens
- Pro Plan - overage: 45,032 tokens -> $90
- Usage adjustments: $0

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-02-28 generated for acct-742. Total tokens billed: 145,032. Charges: $2,090. Generated at 2026-03-01T04:12:11Z.

finance-tyler: tagging finance. two quick possibilities: (1) proration when plan tier changed mid-month, (2) duplicated metering from old/new pipeline. did the customer change tiers in Feb?

anita.chen: acct-742 support history shows a plan change on 2026-02-15 from Starter -> Pro. that could explain partial commit proration + overage, but our dashboard should reflect same units. sam, can you confirm whether your CSV includes both pre/post change usage or if you filtered by plan?

sam.king: CSV is account-wide, no plan filter. i expected invoice line items to sum to the same total tokens (they should be identical units). this looks like tokens were double-counted for a subset of requests.

oliver.p: quick note from metering infra: we rolled the new token-meter v2 on 2026-02-20 behind a feature flag, then enabled globally on 2026-02-27. there was a 3-hour overlap window on 02-27 where both v1 and v2 ingested the same events for the embedding endpoints. logs show duplicate ingest batches for service embedding/lookup between 02:00-05:00 UTC on 2026-02-27. might match the delta.

support-jen: can you run a narrow export for that 3-hour window and grep for duplicate request_ids? sample repro: 

```bash
# from infra query host
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SUPPORT_TOKEN" "https://logs.redwood.ai/query?account=acct-742&from=2026-02-27T02:00:00Z&to=2026-02-27T05:00:00Z&service=embedding" > /tmp/acct742-window.json
jq '.[] | .request_id' /tmp/acct742-window.json | sort | uniq -d | head
```

support-jen: if you find duplicates, please paste 3 sample request_ids. that will let infra correlate to ingestion batches.

sam.king: running now. found duplicates — sample ids: req_89f2, req_a37c, req_1b0d. also seeing doubled token counts for those requests (e.g., 512 -> 1024 in totals).

oliver.p: confirmed. i can see the ingestion batch ids: batch-20260227-02 and batch-20260227-03 both contain the same S3 objects for embedding events. root cause: orchestrator retried a partial list operation and v2 didn't dedupe on object checksum for a short window.

anita.chen: thanks. what's the mitigation plan? finance needs to know refund amount and timeline.

oliver.p: short-term: we can mark affected events as duplicate in billing pipeline and drop the second ingestion before finalizing invoices. i've opened fix PR to add dedupe-by-checksum for v2; deploy to prod in ~2 hrs. long-term: add end-to-end checksum + request_id dedupe in the ingest layer.

finance-tyler: can you estimate number of duplicated tokens for acct-742? i'll calculate refund.

oliver.p: quick query result for acct-742 duplicate window: duplicated tokens = 46,291. that matches the invoice delta.

billing-bot: Action created: BILL-5421 (Dedup affected invoice tokens for acct-742). Assigned to billing team.

support-jen: next steps: (1) infra to run dedupe job against staging copy and validate totals, (2) billing to re-run invoice generation pipeline for acct-742 and issue credit if totals drop, (3) notify customer with proposed refund + explanation.

anita.chen: FYI @finance-tyler I've prepared a draft customer message: "We identified a brief duplication in our ingestion pipeline on Feb 27 that caused extra tokens to be billed. We're issuing a credit of $XX.XX to your account and have fixed the underlying issue. Apologies for the inconvenience." want to review before we send?

finance-tyler: looks good, please include exact credit amount once billing confirms. cc @sam.king on the reply.

sam.king: thanks everyone. please update this thread when the credit posts so i can close the reconciliation ticket. :thumbsup:

oliver.p: deployed dedupe patch at 2026-03-01T06:05:00Z. running dedupe job now; i'll post results in ~30m.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2026-02-28 updated: tokens adjusted to 98,741, credit issued $92.00. Re-generated at 2026-03-01T06:48:13Z.

finance-tyler: refund processed and customer notified. marking this resolved from finance side.

sam.king: confirmed invoice now matches dashboard totals. closing reconciliation on my side. thanks for quick turn. :heart:

support-jen: closing thread — follow-up: we should add a monthly audit check that compares dashboard CSV totals vs invoice token totals and alerts when delta > 1% to catch regressions early. filed SRE-881 for audit job.
